name: Postcard from Brentville
source:
The Big Flat Midwest town of Brentville's main export is loneliness.

Deirdre cradles her doll, and the doll within her. Kenzie is on her way to meet the girl she knows.

Beloved Marmite is always there for you.

[From [url=https://killjill.itch.io/postcardfrombrentville]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
中西部大平坦小镇布伦特维尔的主要出口就是孤独。

迪尔德丽抱着她的洋娃娃，以及她体内的洋娃娃。肯齐正在去见她认识的女孩的路上。

心爱的马麦酱永远在你身边。

[来自[url=https://killjill.itch.io/postcardfrombrentville]itch.io[/url]]
